name: GiftCardNightBurst
label: REPLAY
scenario_text: Fraudsters execute gift-card purchases near $450 between 2 and 4 AM using fresh IPs (under 3 days old) and high transaction velocity (6-14 per hour). Most use a new device and some have geo mismatches. Accounts are 5-180 days old. Evasion: 20% of fraud rows blend toward normal behaviour.

attack_spec.name: GiftCardNightBurst
attack_spec.description: Gift-card transfers near $450 at 2-4 AM, with high velocity and young IPs.

proposed_rule.rationale: Flags gift-card purchases made between midnight and 4 AM with high velocity (>=6/h). These three conditions together isolate the night-burst pattern while avoiding daytime gift-card purchases which are mostly legitimate.
